answer: One identity, one hash chain: each epoch it emits a fresh signal from the last verified answer. Work is appended, each link filed in a public nebula ledger open for replay. At the reef, auditors replay the chain; a fork breaks it and burns the 70-credit bond. First fake 46, k-th 46+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes 2,543,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail: links carry the owner's key. Honest agents keep one chain, pay 46 once, keep their full share.
